messages.author: f6e447b2fd794867
messages.subject: Re: Mosaics for bam files
parts:
Hi Sigrid,

mosaics does not support bam file formats as its direct input but it supports sam file formats instead. There are popular tools to convert bam files to sam files, including samtools:

http://www.biostars.org/post/show/1701/how-can-i-convert-bam-to-sam/
http://samtools.sourceforge.net/
https://main.g2.bx.psu.edu/root?tool_id=bam_to_sam

You can convert bam files to sam files using these tools and then process the output sam files using mosaics package.

Thanks,
Dongjun
